notes.title: Update 0.46 is available! 😱
notes.notes:
Hi Guys! As I promised, Update 4.6 is ready and you can now get this update 😱
Here you can see the list of added features in this update.


 Story Chapter 4 unlocked!
 New Challenge Mod
 Six New Achievements
 Xbox controllers support
 Ukrainian Language (UI+Subtitle)
 Some minor bugs fixed


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42935968/707456c9f1cb9e1d76aba3fc69d54a8ff27f17d2.jpg

Stay tuned for more updates! 😁 I am trying to add more features to the game (Story Chapters, New Challenges, Puzzles...) Maybe you'll find it exciting. I'm looking forward to your comments.

notes.title: Update 0.452
notes.notes:
Hi guys, as promised, the new update is ready! we have added some of the features you requested in this update 😉✌️ Thank you for supporting us 🙏

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42935968/d7c17be2958b66e15f9c5dcc80ec551e97e62448.jpg

 4 New Languages added (Turkish, Russian, Chinese, Korean)
 Achievements now available on easy mod
 Game volume slider added to game settings
 Reset Default controller button added to game settings
 Customization keyboard problem fixed
 Pills collected save system added
 Weapon Reload system is faster now
 Loading freezing problem fixed
